rounds.text: Shree Refrigerations Ltd demonstrates exceptional fundamental momentum, highlighted by a compounded profit growth of 224% over the last 5 years [E15] and a 56% surge in trailing twelve-month sales [E14]. This compounding power easily outpaces sector benchmarks, where the sector median profit growth sits at 20.4% and sales growth at 14.7% [E53, E54]. Valuation multiples also present a compelling relative entry point, with the stock trading at a P/E of 55.08x compared to a lofty sector benchmark of 153.25x, alongside a P/B of 5.37x against a sector benchmark of 8.91x [E6, E7]. Furthermore, the company is conservatively financed with a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.18x and actively reduced its borrowings to Rs 39 Cr in Mar 2026 [E28, E29]. Conceded: the stock trades at an elevated absolute P/E of 55.1 with a negative free cash flow of Rs -11 Cr [E1, E26].
